name: fluent
description: Fluent's public plugins for working with AI: craft skills, daily briefs, marketing tools, 3D design and motion graphics, on the open Agent Skills standard.

plugins.name: fluent-ai-skills
plugins.description: Craft skills for working with AI: building your own agent, finishing work, writing without slop, designing with intent.

plugins.name: daily-brief
plugins.description: A daily industry brief, researched overnight and checked against primary sources, built from an interview about your work.

plugins.name: fluent-marketing-tools
plugins.description: Operating procedures for Pencil design files, Meta ads built through the Ads MCP, and AI video ads made with Higgsfield.

plugins.name: fluent-3d
plugins.description: 3D design and printing skills — set up 3D apps, model parts live in CAD, and slice them ready to print.

plugins.name: fluent-motion
plugins.description: Motion-graphics films built in code, from your posters, logos, footage or a brief, with an original score.

plugins.name: fluent-cad
plugins.description: Computer-aided design skills by track: building plans and quantities, parts and products, 3D printing, and Blender animation and video edits.
